title: Element type flags and compositions
description: Types used only inside structured or block editors must be element types, and element types cannot inherit from non-element types. Checked in the backoffice or the management API on the local copy.

impact.summary: Conversions to block editors need element types for every item type.

handling.option: Fix element flags and compositions through the backoffice or management API, never by raw SQL

checks.text: Every item type used by a structured or block editor is an element type on the local copy
